book.name: BASI TESALONIKE
book.title: MUKAANA A POOLE WU A NSOMO KUNDAA BASI TESALONIKE

content: Nzya-nzyara yi aakagwa Nzaami esee

Bandughu mu kana, mu omana, bihi liigyihi be nki nzya-nzyara be lifaana okala a yo mu ogwa Nzaami esee, ya be lili mu okadzyara obo. Lo mu matala ma, bihi lili mu okaluomo be ya lili mu okatumu be mu nkwumu a Mfumu Yiisu mu ofirigyighili mi miluru.
Mu kuulu, be lisoolo nki maluo bihi liigwi be ma maafi kundaa Mfumu Yiisu.
Dzyi li Nzaami lili ti be likala baara ba bátwulu mu libee mu okala ba baba ndaa nde, linyaã okala a enkwunu.
Nyaã nswe mbwuru mu be agyighili osuolo mukala a nde mu okala kunsa bungili ya budziri.
Nde ka faana onama bisee bi musunu o ti bu ookasa baala ka bali ba-Dzwife o, ba bagwene osoolo Nzaami.

Mu ndagha yi, mbwuru si mumõ anyaã osa bubi bwunu we opfiri ndughu a nde mu kana, mu kuulu bihi liitswama olyele be yo ya osuo bumpughulu bu ndagha yi: Mfumu aakasyeme baara ba baakagyighili mandagha mamo.
Mu kuulu, Nzaami ka aati bihi mbili mpaala bihi likakala kunsa mandagha mama osuŋumu o, lo mu okakala kunsa bungili.
Me mu obo, nswe munde wu aabihi maluo ma, nde ka mbwuru abihi o, lo nde Nzaami wu aakagwa be Mufulu a nde wu a Ngili abihi.
Mu mi mitala dzyi lili bandughu mu kana, be ka lili a nzala a kuulu ti basono be mukaana o, mu kuulu Nzaami aaluo be bunu be lifaana okadzyi babake be a be.
Me obo behe si liikasa kundaa bandughu mu kana bwohono ba bali ku nsie yi a Masedwane yohono. Lo bandughu ba me mu kana, bihi ligwi be mpama mu ofirigye linku-nkulu.
Liikasagha okala kunsa edzuunu, mu okatala yini a mandagha ma beme, ya mu okasala mu myaã mi be, ti bu liigwi bihi be litumu.
Mpaala nzya-nzyara a be yikala yi a budziri ŋa mihi mi baara baala ka bali banga-a-kana o, ya be linyaã okala leme kundaa mbwuru mukimi.
Osighili o banga-a-kana mu lipfu
Bandughu mu kana, bihi ka lidzyi o ti be likala kunsa nzi-nzimini mu mi mitala baara ba bákpi, mpaala be linyaã okala kunsa minyoõ ti anga baara babake ba bagwene a emiini.
Mu kuulu, kala ti bihi liikasa kana ti Yiisu aakpi ya aasighili mu lipfu, bwunu obo si Nzaami akala aasiili mu Yiisu, emõ ya nde baara ba bákpi.
Ligyughu ndagha yi lilyele bihi be, yo yili ndagha yi ólyele Mfumu: Bihi-a-be ba liikala mweẽ tee mu matala ma oogya Mfumu, ka akala liikala ku nkulu a babo ba bátswama okpa o.
Mu kuulu Mfumu ndeme, mu engubu kii litumu, ya mu likyi li mfumu a bangye-yulu ya lili mvulu-a-mvulu a Nzaami, bu aafa ku yulu, sa ayakumunu ya ba bákpi mu Kriste sa batswama osighili mu lipfu.
Ŋa nseele, bihi-a-be ba lili nkini mweẽ, sa baseene bihi-a-be nzili mõ ya bo mu bidzi mu obwana a Mfumu, mu engye-a-ngye. Ya obo me bu liikala bihi-a-be matala mwohono ya Mfumu.
Mu obo, mu mandagha mamo liikagwa be a be bukyini.
